settings.text: Looking for the lowdown on our women’s swimwear? You scrolled to the right place. Our swimwear fabric has 4x the compression and 5x the strength of regular swimwear for a confidence-boosting fit. (We’ve even heard some people call it magic.) From bikinis to one-pieces to long-torso sizes, every style is made for you with our data-backed fit that uses 1.5 million measurements from 10,000 real women. And because we want you to feel good in your suit and good about your purchase, we use recycled materials in all of our swimsuits & our packaging, too.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · In addition to our signature compressi…
settings.text: In addition to our signature compression fabric and data-backed fit, Summersalt swimwear is thoughtfully designed with details that make all the difference—like built-in shelf bras, adjustable straps, and strategic seaming for shaping and support. Whether you’re drawn to timeless black one-piece swimsuits, bold colorblocked styles, or vibrant, vacation-ready prints, you’ll find silhouettes that balance fashion and function. Our high-waisted bikini bottoms, supportive swim tops, and long-torso one-pieces are created to move with you—from ocean swims to poolside lounging.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We believe great women’s swimwear shou…
settings.text: We believe great women’s swimwear should work as hard as you do, which is why our suits are made with durable, quick-drying fabric that holds its shape swim after swim. With inclusive sizing and mix-and-match bikini separates, it’s easy to build a swim wardrobe that feels uniquely yours. Planning a tropical getaway, beach weekend, or simply refreshing your summer style? Dive into our collection of flattering swimsuits designed to deliver comfort, confidence, and standout style all season long.
